name: popover
title: Popover
description: Arbitrary content docked to its trigger (or detached by one gutter), with optional header, body and footer cells.
whenToUse: Use it for a quick edit or a few settings beside the control that opened it, while the page stays live. For a task the page waits for use Dialog; for a label use Tooltip.

parts.name: PopoverFooter
parts.description: A row of cells on the bottom keyline (Button layout="cell"); the cells share its width equally.

parts.name: PopoverHeader
parts.description: Optional header row: title, description and a close cell, on the popover's own keyline.

parts.name: PopoverPopup
parts.description: Arbitrary content docked to its trigger: Base UI's Portal, Positioner and Popup in one part, with the positioner's placement props lifted. The shared edge sits on the trigger's keyline, it unfolds from that edge, it has no cut (an attached surface continues its owner). It carries the configuration of the place it is written. For lists of commands use Menu; for a single choice use Select.

props.name: attachWeight
props.description: Keyline weight of the owner's shared edge: 2 for a standalone control, 1 for a cell (layout="cell").

props.name: detached
props.description: Detached: sits one gutter from the trigger as a control-weight frame, for content not about the trigger itself.

parts.name: PopoverTrigger
parts.description: The element that opens the popover. Rendered as another part (`render={<Button />}`), the element is that part's and carries its data-slot.
